latest.notes: Video Station: HLS playback with VA-API hardware decode/encode, cinema UI 2.0 and mobile parity.

releases.notes: Video Station: HLS playback with VA-API hardware decode/encode, cinema UI 2.0 and mobile parity.
EthOS OS: A/B image updates — check, download, install to the standby slot, reboot or automatic rollback
Provisioning: core updates apply helpers, sudoers, unit and confs from the signed release
Downloads: torrent and hoster-link provider slots, including tb7.pl multihoster support
System: Ubuntu package updates — check, install from Settings → System, reboot prompt
Users: create, edit, disable and delete accounts from Settings, with immediate session revocation
First-run setup asks for a username and password only — the setup code is gone from the wizard by default
Packages: compose binds limited to the package's own files
Downloads: per-user queues, folders, categories and qBittorrent scope
Libraries: per-user gallery, music, video and editor state
Security: per-user filesystem scope — non-admins are limited to their own home, /mnt and /media
Update card: no more phantom update on appliances built from an OS image
Updater: appliances installed from an OS image can update again (shallow clone fetch)
Setup: the first-run card asks for the admin username and password
Setup: pick your own username, not just the password, when claiming a new appliance
Setup: a freshly flashed appliance no longer asks for a code on its own network — just pick the admin password
Setup: the 'EthOS is set up' notification now appears after claiming the appliance
Setup: a freshly flashed appliance can be claimed in the browser with the code shown on its screen — no HDMI keyboard, no default password
Packages: installing a package again works even after a failed start left its directory behind.
Files: reliable video thumbnails — one video stream at a time, thumbnail work yields to active playback
Packages: Update all — every pending update runs sequentially, each with its own rollback
Downloads: per-package speed limit — a shared bandwidth cap for every part of one multi-part package, picked on the package row
Downloads: per-part Skip/Unskip so a broken volume no longer blocks a package, skipped parts are excluded from extraction and reported as pausedDL to Radarr/Sonarr
Downloads: mirror/hoster failover — extra source URLs, per-source retry budget, cross-host resume reset, mirror indicator in the row
Downloads: auto-extract finished archives, manual Extract for a task or package, delete-after-extract setting; updater survives its own restart
